questiontext.text:
Run the code lines below to read in two data frames called gene_data and brain_data.

gene_data <- read_rds("https://github.com/eugene100hickey/ATU-data-handling/raw/refs/heads/master/data/ABA-adult")
brain_data <- read_rds("https://github.com/eugene100hickey/ATU-data-handling/raw/refs/heads/master/data/brain-area-code")

Then join these two data frames together to make one where the first few rows look like this:

hgnc_symbol structure signal brain_area
ACAA1 4024 8.425045 Cerebral Cortex
ACAA1 4355 7.995196 Cerebral Nuclei
ACAA1 4155 8.025882 Cerebral Cortex
ACAA1 4186 8.331045 Cerebral Cortex
ACAA1 4908 8.459142 Cerebral Cortex
ACAA1 4759 7.825108 Cerebellum

hgnc_xsymbol refers to the name of the gene, structure is a code number for the specific brain area, signal measures how active the gene is in this brain area, and brain_area is the name for the general brain area.

Filter this to only look at gene expression from the Cerebellum.

What is the average gene expression in Cerebellum?

generalfeedback.text: Use gene_data |> left_join(brain_data, join_by(structure == brain_code)) and then filter(brain_area == Cerebellum)
